name: Botanical fresco
description: Faded Renaissance fresco and tropical wallpaper: hibiscus, monstera, pineapples and palms, with mischievous animals and classical figures in cracked plaster scenes.
light: soft, warm, faded daylight, low contrast
composition: all-over botanical pattern, or a mural scene in panels with a few animals and figures
camera_or_medium: aged fresco on plaster and hand-printed botanical wallpaper
texture_detail: cracked plaster, chalky muted colour, fine botanical line, gold leaf hints
avoid: copies of a series title sequence
subjects: a monkey stealing fruit among hibiscus
a tiger lounging in a palm garden fresco
pineapples and leaves as a repeating wallpaper
a classical party scene with swans and lilies
